lines.zh: 六条腿一起跑，声音像撒豆子。
lines.en: Six legs run at once, like beans spilled on stone.

lines.zh: 沿着墙根走，光碰不到我。
lines.en: I keep to the wall base where light cannot reach.

lines.zh: 这条缝我昨天还没见过。
lines.en: This crack was not here yesterday.
Torch ahead — around it, quickly.

lines.zh: 我跑得比你的脚抬起来还快。
lines.en: I am faster than your foot can lift.

lines.zh: 石板底下有一条我的路。
lines.en: There is a road of mine beneath these slabs.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩在别人的影子里。
lines.en: Every step I take lands in someone's shadow.

lines.zh: 灰尘厚的地方，说明没人来。
lines.en: Thick dust means nobody comes here.
I follow the cold breath of the water pipe.

lines.zh: 这块地板松了，正好钻进去。
lines.en: This floorboard is loose — perfect to slip under.

lines.zh: 我的触角一直在敲前面的空气。
lines.en: My antennae keep tapping the air ahead.

lines.zh: 慢一步就会被扫帚追上来。
lines.en: One slow step and the broom catches up.
Mud is soft; it costs me legs to run.

lines.zh: 从这块石头到那块，中间不停。
lines.en: Stone to stone, and never stopping between.

lines.zh: 我贴在墙缝里，等脚步声过去。
lines.en: I press into the wall seam and let the steps pass.

lines.zh: 月光照到的地方，我一步都不踩。
lines.en: I will not take one step where moonlight falls.
Must get back before sunset.
Why is this rock always here?
Tired of walking, I'll graze.
I know every damp floor seam.
I smell rain coming.
Tender grass up ahead, I think.
Don't rush me. I'm walking.
This meadow is awfully big.
One more lap, then another.
Grass here, path there.
How far must I walk today?
My hooves are getting sore.
I know this ground by heart.
Six legs scurry faster than anyone.
Steadiest steps. That's me.
Step by step, we'll get there.

lines.zh: 我把触角收回来，舔干净。
lines.en: I pull in my antennae and clean them.

lines.zh: 墙缝里比外面暖和一点。
lines.en: The wall crack is a little warmer than outside.

lines.zh: 有米粒的味道，从上方飘下来。
lines.en: A grain of rice smells down from above.

lines.zh: 他们说我活过了一场大灾。
lines.en: They say I lived through a great dying.

lines.zh: 壳上的油光是我自己擦的。
lines.en: The shine on my shell is my own polishing.
By day I count the cracks in the wall.

lines.zh: 我把卵鞘藏在柜子背面。
lines.en: I hide my egg case behind the cupboard.

lines.zh: 太阳一出来，我就得换地方。
lines.en: Once the sun is up, I must move again.

lines.zh: 一只鞋底压不死所有蟑螂。
lines.en: One sole cannot kill every cockroach.

lines.zh: 我听见木头里有虫在咬。
lines.en: I hear something chewing inside the wood.

lines.zh: 潮气重的时候，我的翅膀发软。
lines.en: In damp air my wings go soft.

lines.zh: 屋子安静下来，才轮到我出门。
lines.en: The house must go quiet before I come out.
Standing still is a skill.
Eyes open, brain resting.
Spacing out takes talent.
I'll stay like this a while.
There's a bug on my nose.
Just spacing out.
Shh. I'm counting ants.
Everything is quiet.
Where was I just now?
This shade is nice and cool.
Sky's blue. Very boring.
Ear twitched. Wasn't me.
Simple life. Not bad.
Someone calling? No one.
Did I forget to eat?
The wind smells of grass.

lines.zh: 你的鞋抬起来了，我看见了。
lines.en: Your shoe is lifting; I saw it.

lines.zh: 你手里的灯，往旁边挪一点。
lines.en: Move that lamp of yours off to the side.

lines.zh: 你踩过的地方，我都不去。
lines.en: I avoid every place your feet have been.
I know that posture — bending down to strike.
Not that slipper; it is worn out anyway.
You carry the smell of the kitchen on you.

lines.zh: 你比我大这么多，还是抓不到我。
lines.en: You are far bigger, and still cannot catch me.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住我了，谢谢。
lines.en: Your shadow covers me — thank you.
Opening the cupboard? Then I go first.

lines.zh: 灯一亮，你就看不见墙角了。
lines.en: Once the light is on, you lose the corners.
Farmer, or just passing through?
You must be new here.
I am gone before your foot comes down.
Oh. It's you.
Don't step on the grass beside me.
Don't come so close so fast.
Your hat is strange.

lines.zh: 铁锈味，还有面包屑的味。
lines.en: Rust smell, and a hint of breadcrumbs.
You're tall. Bend down.
We meet again, human.
There are crumbs stuck in the seam of your heel.
Why not stay a while?
My shell cracked, and I can still run.

lines.zh: 你踩偏了，只压到一条腿。
lines.en: You missed; only one leg is pinned.
That was heavy; I have noted it.
One of my wings is crumpled now.
It hurts, and the pain will not stop me squeezing through.
You knocked off half an antenna.
I am still alive, and that is enough.

lines.zh: 别追，我钻进这块板子底下。
lines.en: Stop chasing; I am under this board.

lines.zh: 我的血是淡黄的，不好看吧。
lines.en: My blood is pale yellow — not pretty, is it?
The more you hit, the more I zigzag.
Is my leg still there?
Don't come close while I hurt.

lines.zh: 我钻过石缝就够了，别管我。
lines.en: I just need to slip through a stone gap; leave me alone.
My shell is dented, but I can still crawl.
Am I hurt?
Ow ow ow. Easy.
Hurts. I won't cry.
I need a moment.

lines.zh: 我的触须竖起来了，别踩。
lines.en: My antennae are up; do not step on me.

lines.zh: 我的腿断了两条，照样跑。
lines.en: Two legs gone, and I still run.

lines.zh: 那块饼干屑，掉在桌腿旁边。
lines.en: That biscuit crumb fell right by the table leg.
I am not picky; I can eat anything.

lines.zh: 你把吃的放在地上，我就过来。
lines.en: Set the food on the floor, and I will come.

lines.zh: 别拿手递，你的手太快了。
lines.en: Do not hand it over; your hand is too quick.
This peel is not rotten yet; it is mine.

lines.zh: 我闻到油了，从灶台那边。
lines.en: I smell grease, from the stove side.

lines.zh: 吃的掉在地上，就不算你的了。
lines.en: Food that hits the floor is no longer yours.

lines.zh: 我可以吃一口，然后立刻跑。
lines.en: I will take one bite, then run.
A crumb is easier to carry than a grain.

lines.zh: 你把碗推开，底下肯定有东西。
lines.en: Push the bowl aside; there is always something under it.
For me? Really?
Don't stop. Keep holding it.
Don't hold it so high.
Better than wild grass by far.
Is that grass? Smells great.
Whoever holds grass is a friend.
Every crumb on the floor is mine.
That smell makes my knees weak.
Walk slow. I'm right here.
You really get me.
I'd run for this.
I'll follow. Just hold it there.
Steady your hand. I might nip it.
Can't look away.
Can I have one more?
My mouth is watering itself.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的翅膀了，能抬一下吗。
lines.en: You stepped on my wing; could you lift your foot?

lines.zh: 我从你鞋边擦过去，别动。
lines.en: I brushed past your shoe; hold still.

lines.zh: 你脚跟落地的时候，我差点没了。
lines.en: When your heel came down, I nearly ended.
This close, your breathing is heavy.

lines.zh: 让一让，我要钻到柜子下面。
lines.en: Make room; I am going under the cupboard.

lines.zh: 你两脚之间正好有条路。
lines.en: There is a path exactly between your feet.

lines.zh: 撞一下没关系，我的壳硬。
lines.en: A bump is nothing; my shell is hard.

lines.zh: 你的裤子擦到墙，灰尘全下来了。
lines.en: Your trousers brushed the wall and brought the dust down.
You have squeezed me into the wall crack.

lines.zh: 抱歉，我从你的影子里穿过去了。
lines.en: Sorry, I cut straight through your shadow.
I'm seeing stars now.
Once was enough.
This path is far too narrow.
You stepped on my hoof.
Queue up! Everyone queue!
Don't shove. I'm not a wall.
What's your hurry?
I wasn't even moving!
Hey! Watch where you're going!
Are my bones still whole?

lines.zh: 我绕着那只雌虫转了六圈。
lines.en: I circle her six times, one for each leg.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀摩擦出很轻的声音。
lines.en: My wings rub out a very thin sound.

lines.zh: 这只卵鞘里会有很多小家伙。
lines.en: This egg case will hold a great many little ones.

lines.zh: 帮我看着门口，别让光进来。
lines.en: Watch the door for me; keep the light out.

lines.zh: 我拖来一块糖，放在她旁边。
lines.en: I drag a piece of sugar and set it beside her.

lines.zh: 她的触角比我的短一点。
lines.en: Her antennae are a little shorter than mine.

lines.zh: 耐心点，我们得先找个暗处。
lines.en: Be patient; we need a dark place first.
This corner is warm enough, and cramped enough.
I do not dance; I tap the floor.

lines.zh: 等卵鞘硬了，我就把它藏好。
lines.en: Once the case hardens, I will hide it well.

lines.zh: 我从春天就注意到你了。
lines.en: I noticed you since spring.
Our little ones will be strong.
So we're a pair now?
You smell like sunshine.
I've groomed my coat.
We'll graze together from now on.

lines.zh: 我的卵鞘会粘在墙缝里。
lines.en: My egg case will stick in the wall crack.
Don't be shy. Look at me.
Your horns are beautiful.
I saved the tenderest grass for you.

lines.zh: 这块糖我扛得动，你别管。
lines.en: I can carry this sugar; leave me to it.

lines.zh: 米粒要咬着走，不然会掉。
lines.en: A grain must be carried in my jaws or it drops.

lines.zh: 谁掉的面包渣，我先收了。
lines.en: Someone dropped a bread crumb; I claim it.
Dragging is faster than holding for me.

lines.zh: 这张纸太轻，风一吹就跑。
lines.en: This paper is so light the draft takes it.

lines.zh: 我把碎屑推到墙缝深处。
lines.en: I push the scraps deep into the wall crack.

lines.zh: 东西多得搬不完，先藏一半。
lines.en: Too much to carry; I hide half of it first.

lines.zh: 这块果核比我大，慢慢来吧。
lines.en: This pit is bigger than I am; slowly, then.

lines.zh: 不是吃的我也捡，能垫窝。
lines.en: I take non-food too; it lines the nest.

lines.zh: 你别伸手，剩下的我自己搬。
lines.en: Keep your hands off; I will move the rest.
Better than my old stick.
So shiny. Very pretty.
I'll hide it in my fur.
My collection grows.
My mouth had room.
I slip through every brick crack.
One isn't enough. Want more.

lines.zh: 面包屑里混了颗小石子。
lines.en: There is a pebble mixed in with the bread crumbs.
Who's watching me pick this up?
I can carry it. Don't worry.

lines.zh: 是只小虫，比米粒大不了多少。
lines.en: A small bug, barely bigger than a grain of rice.

lines.zh: 它挡在我回墙缝的路上了。
lines.en: It is blocking my way back to the crack.

lines.zh: 我先绕一圈，看看它会不会动。
lines.en: I circle once to see whether it moves.
This thing is soft; it should bite easily.
It is slower than I am, so there is no problem.
My jaws are small, but they will do.
Test it first; do not get bitten back.

lines.zh: 这里是我的地盘，它走错了。
lines.en: This is my ground, and it walked in wrong.
The moment it stops, I go.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢打架，但也不躲。
lines.en: I do not like fighting, but I do not hide either.
The herd's on me.
For the little ones, I won't retreat.

lines.zh: 我的触角已经碰到你了。
lines.en: My antennae have already touched you.
Let me breathe before I charge.
I can't swallow this.
Come closer. Try it.
You cannot squeeze into that crack by the wall.
I've got you in sight. Back off.
You crossed the line.
Horns toward you, and I can slip into any crack.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，翅膀贴着背。
lines.en: I flatten down, wings tight to my back.

lines.zh: 它抬脚的方向，我算得出来。
lines.en: I can predict which way it lifts a leg.

lines.zh: 我数着它的腿，找最软的那条。
lines.en: I count its legs for the softest one.
The corner is narrow; it will turn slowly.

lines.zh: 我的触角已经碰到它了。
lines.en: My antennae have already touched it.
I wait until it crawls into the light.

lines.zh: 我从上面走，那里没声音。
lines.en: I take the upper path; it makes no sound.

lines.zh: 它看不见我贴在墙缝里。
lines.en: It cannot see me pressed into the crack.
One strike is enough; I do not want a struggle.

lines.zh: 我后腿蹬紧了，随时能跳。
lines.en: My hind legs are loaded, ready to spring.

lines.zh: 墙缝里我钻得比谁都快。
lines.en: I squeeze through wall cracks fastest.
I'll be right there.
Stop! Just one word!
Turning won't help you.
You can't outrun me... right?
After this I need grass.
Chasing is hard work.
Beyond this crack, I will be waiting.
Wait. My hooves hurt.
Don't run! I'm slow!

lines.zh: 咬了就跑，这是我的打法。
lines.en: Bite and run; that is how I fight.

lines.zh: 我的颚比针尖大不了多少。
lines.en: My jaws are barely bigger than a needle.
It curled up — perfect.

lines.zh: 这一口很轻，可我咬了很多次。
lines.en: Each bite is light, but I bite many times.

lines.zh: 我不松口，除非它翻过来。
lines.en: I do not let go unless it rolls over.

lines.zh: 六条腿全压上去，它就动不了。
lines.en: All six legs pressed down and it cannot move.

lines.zh: 我的壳被它的刺刮了一道。
lines.en: Its spines scraped a line across my shell.
It is bleeding; I should hurry.

lines.zh: 咬完这一口，我退到缝里。
lines.en: After this bite, I back into the crack.
Never underestimate small teeth.
Hind legs, and off you go!
My head is very hard.
Take a kick!

lines.zh: 屋角的缝隙，都是我的路。
lines.en: Every crack in the wall is my road.
Hitting makes me dizzy.
My horns aren't decoration.
One headbutt. Just one!
Done. Let's all graze now.
Don't blame me. You started it.
Don't blame me if you fly.

lines.zh: 我从卵鞘里爬出来，壳还是软的。
lines.en: I crawl from the egg case, shell still soft.

lines.zh: 周围的腿比我的身体还多。
lines.en: There are more legs around me than my body has.

lines.zh: 我先找一块最暗的地方。
lines.en: First I find the darkest patch I can.
There is warm air under this floorboard.

lines.zh: 一出生我就知道要躲光。
lines.en: I knew to avoid light the moment I hatched.

lines.zh: 到处是兄弟姐妹，我们不打招呼。
lines.en: Siblings everywhere; we do not greet each other.

lines.zh: 我试了试翅膀，还飞不起来。
lines.en: I tried my wings; they cannot lift me yet.

lines.zh: 木头的味道，说明这里有人住。
lines.en: The smell of wood says people live here.
I follow the wall base and learn the way.
The world is so much larger than the egg case.
A new day again.

lines.zh: 石头底下，总还能挤进去。
lines.en: Under a stone, there is always room.
Hello, world. I'm here.
I'm Cockroach. Nice to meet you.
I need to find a meadow.
Is this meadow?
Legs are wobbly.
Hi all. I'm new.
First thing in life: eat.
I remember a little.

lines.zh: 火把离得太近，我的触角卷了。
lines.en: The torch was too close; my antennae curled.
Who lit this? Put it out!

lines.zh: 从柜台掉下来，翻了个身才站稳。
lines.en: I fell off the counter and landed on my back first.
I fell. Legs first.

lines.zh: 水槽里有水，我差点浮不起来。
lines.en: There was water in the sink; I nearly could not float.
Who dug this deep ditch?

lines.zh: 整面墙塌了，我被埋在灰里。
lines.en: A whole wall came down and buried me in dust.
What just exploded?

lines.zh: 有根针扎进来，差点把我钉在墙上。
lines.en: A needle went through me and nearly pinned me to the wall.
Something's stuck in me!

lines.zh: 那股紫色的光让我腿都乱了。
lines.en: That purple light scrambled all my legs.
This isn't ordinary pain.

lines.zh: 角落扫得太干净，一点渣都没有。
lines.en: They swept the corner clean, not one crumb left.
Grass... just a little.

lines.zh: 雷打在屋顶，光从瓦缝漏下来。
lines.en: Lightning struck the roof and light leaked through the tiles.
My fur is all singed.

lines.zh: 脚下没有板子了，一直往下掉。
lines.en: No floorboard under me, only falling.
I want to go back and graze.
